match_id: MARESCA: “SOMETHING WRONG HAPPENED!”  Arsenal_Man City  FA Community Shield_2026-08-16_u9Zimxv3o8I
speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
What was your reflection? I think a big part  of the game is in the first goal we concede.  
Unfortunately, after 30 seconds, we concede the  first one. I think after the goal we concede, the  
reaction was good. Before they scored the second  goal, we had three or four chances to score and to  
draw the game. Unfortunately, we missed the chance  and then, with the second goal, it became more  
difficult. It's never nice to lose 3-0, but do  you think that the manner of the three goals was  
particularly concerning to you? Do you think some  of the defending made it slightly easy for Arsenal  
today? In general, I'm always concerned even when  we win games. So imagine now that we didn't win  
the game. But we just, we just, you know, we just  start. This just is the beginning. We have many  
things that we need to do better. But again,  I think it was a good reaction after the first  
goal we concede, and now try to reset, analyse  the game and think from Tuesday about the next  
game. When you think about the game today, is  there one particular thing that you don't like  
and one thing that maybe can be a good point of  restart? For sure, the two first goals we concede.  
I didn't like the first one because it's after 25  seconds. And the second one, I think there was no  
pressure on, you know, on the ball, probably. I  don't know if it's for physical condition. We had  
many players, probably the club with more players  in the World Cup. I don't know the reason why,  
but for sure the first two goals that we concede  I don't like. And then, in terms of things that  
I like, I think after the first goal we concede,  the reaction was very good. At this level, it's  
so [inaudible] when you concede the goal and you  are able to react. And the way we react was good.  
But again, after the second goal I think it was  all complicated. Hi, Enzo. With the result today  
and the transfer window still being open, has this  result made you feel that there's a need to bring  
in any new players before the window shuts? We  knew already before the game the things that we  
need to do. It's not because we lost the game, or  even if we were winning the game, we were thinking  
a different way. We are quite clear what we need  to do and, for sure, as I said, we are going to do  
something before the window transfer closes. The  game was very highly contested in midfield today,  
where it felt maybe you were lacking slightly.  Do you feel you missed Rodri's influence at all  
today? But I think, again, I said already, Rodri  is a player that just won the World Cup, Ballon  
d'Or. He's a top player that all the teams, they  need a player like Rodri. So it's not about if we  
miss Rodri or not. I think the ones that played  today, I think Elliot was quite good. It was his  
first game. Mateo... But yeah, again, I think we  can find many things after this kind of defeat.  
We just need, you know, to be... to analyse in the  right way and think about and focus about the next  
one. Enzo, just your thinking on starting so many  of the players who had only just come back? Yeah,  
yeah. We decided to start with... I think  there were four with just two or three  
sessions. And the reason why was also because  sometimes players, you know, they prefer to start,  
do the pre-warm-up and start from the beginning.  And the plan with all of them, as you saw, was to  
change them after 45 minutes, one hour maximum.  So it's a decision that you take before the game,  
if you start or they go inside from the second  half. And [inaudible] seemed to have a problem  
at the end? Yeah, he looks okay after the game.  We see now. Enzo, you were able to give Jack  
Grealish a run-out. That's his first appearance  for City in over a year. How did you think he did?  
Jack was inside when we were 2-0 down. It was  already, you know, the game already became  
complicated after that. But overall, I think Jack  was good. And again, the ones that are still here,  
they're gonna work every day and if they  deserve, they're gonna get minutes. Has  
there been any change of thinking? Has Grealish  got a chance of remaining at the club beyond...?  
Again, at the moment, the window transfer is open  and we see, we see what happens. The first goal,  
how did you view it? It seemed like it was too  easy to play through midfield. Was that sort  
of a concentration thing or not? No, because after  that the reaction was good. Before we concede the  
second goal, I think we didn't concede any shot  and we had three or four chances to score and  
to draw the game. So I don't think it was the lack  of concentration. I need to review and to analyse,  
but at the moment I don't think it was lack of  concentration. In that first sort of moment when  
you got played through midfield, it just  seemed like not really... Yeah, for sure,  
something wrong happened. Probably we were not,  you know, we were not too switched on still,  
you know, still there. But we're gonna  see. We're gonna review when we see. Enzo,  
how confident would you be of having new players  in before [inaudible]? There are indications  
that Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille is still in  discussions with you. No, he's still a Lille  
player. But any new signing, any new player, for  sure, as soon as they arrive, it's better because  
we're going to start the Premier League in one  week. And if they start to work with us as soon  
as possible, it's better because they can also  understand the way we want to play. Thank you.
title: MARESCA: “SOMETHING WRONG HAPPENED!”  Arsenal 3-0 Man City  FA Community Shield
